description_sq: Duplexi ndodhet tek rruga Ndre Mjeda , rezidenca ALBA e cila ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese shume te mire! Pozicionohet ne katin e tete dhe te nente te nje ndertimi teper cilesor me dy ashensore. Disponojme dhe poste parkimi me cmim extra. Per me shume informacion ose vizite ne prone jeni te lutur te na kontaktoni !
description_en: The duplex is located on Ndre Mjeda street, the ALBA residence, which offers all the facilities for a very good life! It is located on the eighth and ninth floor of a high-quality building with two elevators. We also have parking posts at an extra cost. For more information or a visit to the property, please contact us!
